ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity dominant; approximately 95% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 5% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous solid dark charcoal field across both lobes. High-contrast white linear streaks concentrated in the mid-left lobe. High-contrast white/tan clusters localized on the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees; vertex depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels creating a jagged silhouette across the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to pointed, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast tan and white circular clusters (barnacle colonies) densely packed on the extreme distal tips and along the outer leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct high-contrast white linear disruptions; prominent cluster of 5-7 parallel diagonal scratches on the left lobe; scattered horizontal marks on the central-left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant distal tip irregularity caused by barnacle encrustation; several deep-tissue notches visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe that break the primary curve.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent vertical high-intensity mark located at the base of the fluke near the peduncle midline.
